data.name: Tarky Money Clippy
data.teaser: A specialized 1x5 wallet container for currencies and keycards, designed for SpecialSlot3 with a useful content overlay.
data.description:
Tarky Money Clippy

My First mod YAY

A specialized 1x5 wallet container designed to hold various currencies and keycards. The wallet can only be placed in SpecialSlot3 (the third special slot) and provides a useful content overlay when equipped.

Features

-1x1 external size - Takes minimal inventory space -1x5 internal grid - Vertical layout optimized for SpecialSlot3 -Currency support - Holds Roubles, Dollars, Euros, GP Coins, and Bitcoin -Keycard support - Can hold electronic keys and keycards -Special slot compatibility - Only works in SpecialSlot3 -Shows contents when equipped - Displays wallet contents when placed in special slot -Customizable limits - Configurable currency stack limits -Loot pool integration - Should be able to be found naturally in raids

Tarky Money Clippy

A specialized 1x5 wallet container designed to hold various currencies and keycards. The wallet can only be placed in SpecialSlot3 (the third special slot) and provides a useful content overlay when equipped.

Features

-1x1 external size - Takes minimal inventory space
-1x5 internal grid - Vertical layout optimized for SpecialSlot3
-Currency support - Holds Roubles, Dollars, Euros, GP Coins, and Bitcoin
-Keycard support - Can hold electronic keys and keycards
-Special slot compatibility - Only works in SpecialSlot3
-Shows contents when equipped - Displays wallet contents when placed in special slot
-Customizable limits - Configurable currency stack limits
-Loot pool integration - Should be able to be found naturally in raids
